review_role: private read-only targeted primary-literature boundary check; not student competition prose
scope: Close certified RB state/adjoint-gradient bounds, Helmholtz/coarse-space certification, and transform-based spectral multiplication. A narrow search is not a systematic review and cannot prove novelty or priority.

sources.title: A Certified Trust Region Reduced Basis Approach to PDE-Constrained Optimization
sources.established: Primal/dual residual error bounds and the three-term state/adjoint/product gradient-error expansion for quadratic costs.
sources.scope_difference: Coercive elliptic/parabolic RB setting; does not directly provide our current complex-indefinite component constants.

sources.title: A non-conforming dual approach for adaptive Trust-Region Reduced Basis approximation of PDE-constrained optimization
sources.established: Explicit distinction between physical plug-in inexact gradients and true reduced-objective derivatives, with a posteriori gradient bounds.
sources.scope_difference: Their NCD-corrected reduced functional is not our sequential coarse-corrected state/adjoint proposal.

sources.authors: Sen, Veroy, Huynh, Deparis, Nguyen, Patera
sources.title: Natural norm a posteriori error estimators for reduced basis approximations
sources.checked_locations: Abstract; Section6 deflated output estimates; Section7 offline/online cost
sources.established: Certified noncoercive Helmholtz RB outputs, inf-sup lower bounds and deflation near singular modes.
sources.scope_difference: Linear-functional output analysis; not our exact receiver least-squares directional implementation.

sources.title: Comparison of Two-Level Preconditioners Derived from Deflation, Domain Decomposition and Multigrid Methods
sources.established: Classical coarse matrix E=Z^TAZ and correction/projection Q=ZE^-1Z^T.
sources.scope_difference: Their convergence comparison assumes SPD matrices; no transfer of those convergence claims to our complex Helmholtz matrix.

sources.title: Fast Structured Direct Spectral Methods for Differential Equations with Variable Coefficients, I. The One-Dimensional Case
sources.established: Fast-transform spectral multiplication/operator assembly for variable coefficients and structured spectral solvers.
sources.scope_difference: Fourier/Chebyshev 1D setting, not this selected DST-I low-mode 2D coupling Gram identity.

sources.title: A fast numerical method for the conductivity of heterogeneous media with Dirichlet boundary conditions based on discrete sine–cosine transforms
sources.checked_locations: Publisher indexed abstract; direct full-text open403
sources.established: Sine-Galerkin Dirichlet discretization with elementary integrals evaluated by sine/cosine transforms.
sources.scope_difference: Conductivity solver, not our Helmholtz stability certificate. Full derivation not inspected in this narrow review.

sources.title: A Discrete Sine-Cosine Transforms Galerkin Method for the Conductivity of Heterogeneous Materials With Mixed Dirichlet/Neumann Boundary Conditions
sources.established: DCT/DST type-I/III evaluation of Galerkin integrals for heterogeneous conductivity.
sources.scope_difference: Related spectral-assembly motif; not evidence that the exact two-DCT Gram recipe has or has not appeared before.

sources.title: A numerically stable a posteriori error estimator for reduced basis approximations of elliptic equations
sources.established: Traditional residual-norm Gram evaluation can suffer cancellation; a dedicated orthonormal residual basis improves stability.
sources.scope_difference: Does not validate our heuristic PSD shift. Its warning motivates independent floating-point reliability work.

sources.title: An adaptive localized orthogonal decomposition method for Helmholtz problems
sources.established: Helmholtz residual-certified coarse spaces, additive-Schwarz enrichment and POD compression across load families.
sources.scope_difference: LOD/load-family/coarse-space framework, not our frozen global POD parameter-gradient certificate; no gradient analysis identified in the inspected text.

structure_specific_observation: The present mass coefficient has one parameter per grid cell. Standard small-affine-complexity RB offline/online claims do not automatically make that grid-sized parameter complexity free. The fast DCT stability assembly exploits the fixed discrete sine structure; full-grid POD mass projection and residual stencils remain paid work.
